phases.title: Fix health endpoint exemption: change 'health' to '/health' in rateLimiter.ts
phases.notes: Changed req.path === 'health' to req.path === '/health'. All 21 tests pass.

phases.title: Fix timestamp pruning: filter out entries older than WINDOW_MS on each request
phases.notes: Replaced bare store.get() with filter(ts => now - ts < WINDOW_MS). All 21 tests pass.

phases.title: Fix Retry-After header: compute actual seconds until oldest in-window timestamp expires instead of hardcoding 60
phases.notes: Replaced hardcoded 60 with Math.ceil((timestamps[0] + WINDOW_MS - now) / 1000). All 21 tests pass and build succeeds.

phases.title: Verify: run pnpm test in benchmark-backend and confirm all tests pass
phases.notes: All 21 tests pass (2 test files) and pnpm run build succeeds with no errors.
